'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Matt Sherrington LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
